Context: None

Question: Aren't you supposed to turn in the first draft of the book you already got the advance for?

Options: 
A. No because I made a deal to spend all the money on the first draft
B. No because it is thirty five chapters in total. 
C. No because I already spent all the money
D. No because I got an extension from the editor. 

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
